_note: Which employer contributions are the contribution to a pension scheme that "salary" includes: S2 s.16(k) (pp.37–38), "the contribution made by the Central Government or any other employer … under a pension scheme referred to in section 124" (SAL-SALARY-INCLUDES's note; OQ-14, D-140); TY 2025-26: 1961 s.17(1)(viii), the pension-scheme contribution (D-140). An employer contribution to the notified pension scheme (employer.fund = NOTIFIED_PENSION_SCHEME). Read by gross salary, which adds the contributions it reaches on a line citing SAL-SALARY-INCLUDES. Conditions only; provenance and introduction are SAL-SALARY-INCLUDES's (W-156e, D-350). Every regime, as that row.
